notes: The SV10 battery procedure also applies to the V8 Animal when it uses the same SV10 battery style. The charger is Dyson-only.

gaps: The guides and the manual page give no voltage, capacity, cell count, motor type or part numbers.
A third-party comment lists 21.6 V and 4000 mAh, which is not a documented spec, so it was not used.
method: The iFixit device page and the V8 Animal battery guide (130540) name the V8 Animal.
The iFixit SV10 battery guide (224767) names the SV10 marking.
Readable sources document a lithium-ion battery, a Dyson-only charger, and a bin filter and an intake filter.
Qty, ext and obs are editorial values, not source claims.

comps.spec: Lithium-ion battery. The guide's parts list names only 'Dyson V8 Battery', with no part number, voltage, capacity or cell count. Step 2 says to check the bottom label near the battery for the SV10 marking.
Dyson charger for the SV10. The manual says only Dyson chargers may be used, and gives 5 hours to fully charge.
Bin filter. The iFixit device page lists a replacement guide for it (guide 130420). No part number or size is given.
Intake filter. The iFixit device page lists a replacement guide for it (guide 130541). No part number or size is given.
